fields.summary: This amends a master contract with the Alameda County Health Care Services Agency. The county reimburses the district for actual expenses, up to $20,000, to remove barriers and expand access to health and wellness services for unaccompanied immigrant youth. The period is July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022, and all other terms stay the same.

22-0651.sourceIssue: The text says the District is "accepting/adding" $20,000.00 under a master contract with the Alameda County Health Care Services Agency without stating plainly whether the District receives or pays that amount.
